name: #ptifrmtgtframe
summary: The iframe (name TargetContent) holding a classic component inside the portal.
body: Everything in the component is inside it: `f = page.frame_locator("#ptifrmtgtframe")`, then `f.locator(...)`. Not there when the page was opened at its /psc/ URL, or for most Fluid pages.
source: general PeopleSoft knowledge: verify on your PeopleTools version

name: TargetContent
summary: The name of the classic component iframe (#ptifrmtgtframe).
body: `page.frame(name="TargetContent")` gives the Frame object, for code that needs a Frame rather than a FrameLocator.
source: general PeopleSoft knowledge: verify on your PeopleTools version

name: /psc/
summary: A component's URL without the portal: the page alone, with no TargetContent frame.
body: Swap `psp` for `psc` in a component URL. The easiest way to keep frames out of a test of one component.
source: general PeopleSoft knowledge: verify on your PeopleTools version

name: /psp/
summary: A component's URL inside the portal (header plus the TargetContent frame).
source: general PeopleSoft knowledge: verify on your PeopleTools version

name: RECORD_FIELD$row
summary: A field's id: record, underscore, field, and in scrolls and grids $row (from 0).
body: The $ needs an attribute selector or escaping in CSS: `[id='JOB_DEPTID$1']` or `#JOB_DEPTID\$1`.
source: general PeopleSoft knowledge: verify on your PeopleTools version

name: #WAIT_win0
summary: The processing indicator in classic pages, shown during a server round trip.
body: Wait for it to hide after an action: `expect(page.locator("#WAIT_win0")).to_be_hidden()`. Check what your PeopleTools version shows while busy.
source: general PeopleSoft knowledge: verify on your PeopleTools version

name: #ICSave
summary: The Save toolbar button: its id includes the #.
body: A round trip: wait for processing, then read the message box.
source: general PeopleSoft knowledge: verify on your PeopleTools version

name: #ICList
source: general PeopleSoft knowledge: verify on your PeopleTools version

name: #ICSearch
summary: The Search button on a component's search page.
source: general PeopleSoft knowledge: verify on your PeopleTools version

name: #ICOK
summary: The OK button of a PeopleSoft message box: its id includes the #.
body: The box may be in a modal iframe (#ptModFrame_0) on some versions.
source: general PeopleSoft knowledge: verify on your PeopleTools version

name: #ptModFrame_N
summary: The iframe a modal dialog or message box may be in (numbered from 0).
source: general PeopleSoft knowledge: verify on your PeopleTools version

name: #userid
summary: The sign-on page's user id field (#pwd is the password).
source: general PeopleSoft knowledge: verify on your PeopleTools version

name: frame_locator
summary: Locate inside an iframe: the way into a classic component (#ptifrmtgtframe) or a modal (#ptModFrame_N).
body: A FrameLocator's `locator(...)` waits for the frame and its content like any locator.

name: expect
summary: Playwright's retrying assertions: they wait until true (5 seconds by default) instead of checking once.
body: Use them after every round trip instead of reading values straight away.

name: storage_state
summary: Save a signed-in session and start new contexts with it: sign in once per run.
